description: Nature Based Solutions: Evidence for Hazard Risk Reduction and Ecosystem Services is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Institute for Defense Analyses. This report from the Institute for Defense Analyses evaluated the effectiveness of 23 nature-based solutions to address hazards and provide ecosystem services. The report provides recommendations to systematically consider the benefits of nature-based solutions and to accelerate research, innovation, and adaptive learning. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Changing Seasons, Drought, Flooding – General, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply, Aquatic and Marine Resources, Forestry, Natural Areas and Wildlife, Urban Landscape and Tree Canopy, Water Infrastructure – General. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
